resources.string: Make Home comfortable from your seat.
App size, spacing and motion. More apps per row makes them smaller.
Find and arrange apps. Enabled launcher profiles keep separate favorites, not streaming accounts.
Offline themes and pictures. Live backgrounds are silent and stop when you leave Home.
Shortcuts, inputs and optional extras. Bluetooth opens TV settings.
Effects, startup and reset. Browsing changes no TV settings.
Up/Down: categories · OK: open · Back: return

Reset saved layout, spacing, animation and wallpaper choices to the theme’s defaults. This also resets the startup-app choice in Current Home. App order, media files and TV system settings stay saved.
